deliverables: Independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics
Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, hardware wallet support, and wallet data export work
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, improvements, support, infrastructure, audits/oversight, and administration.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available on web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 of annual costs for 12 months.
Eternl plans to introduce Personal and Company Pro plans priced at $96/year and $360/year, and says about 5,500 paying users would cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl reports an install base of about 100,000 browser-extension users and about 30,000 Android and iOS users.
After withdrawal, Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The Audits allocation is for independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027, covering custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and repayments or refunds.
Eternl states that every December and June it will repay treasury surplus when remaining treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income exceed $420,000, until $420,000 equivalent has been repaid in Ada.
Eternl says 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
Eternl states its main UI will not be open-source, while some libraries used in Eternl will be published through its npm organization.
Eternl states that without treasury funding it may let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, or remove the free option if paid licenses are insufficient.

summary: The document asks for ₳2,350,000 administered by Tastenkunst GmbH for 12 months of Eternl operations from August 2026 to July 2027, with a stated $420,000 annual cost, planned Pro-plan sustainability path, public-wallet custody, audits, and conditional treasury repayment, but several high-materiality adoption and counterfactual-risk claims are asserted without evidence in the document.
